body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

The second sentence restates the static_assert message directly below ("the owner holds the plane and nothing else") and the memcpy in bytes_of. The purpose of the type is the one fact left.

// The plane's bytes, copied out (bytes_of) for the physical-layout checks.
